_meta.description: Lintable visual AI-tell tokens, era-tagged. Sibling of vocabulary.json (text). Source: research/visual-ai-tells.md. The deny-list is the floor; fingerprint.json supplies the allow-list (a user-chosen accent is not a tell).

evidence.tailwind_indigo: Adam Wathan public apology for bg-indigo-500 as Tailwind UI default; dev.to/alanwest 'Blame Tailwind's Indigo-500'
evidence.audit: developersdigest 'AI Design Slop: 16 Patterns' — dark 34%, gradient bg 27%, icon-card 22%
evidence.fonts: r/ClaudeAI 'spot a Claude app by its fonts'; Anthropic cookbook says avoid Inter

hard_ban._comment: The purple problem + literal defaults. Allow-listed if fingerprint chose them.

patterns.msg: Tailwind indigo-500/600 — the AI 'purple problem' default
gradient-clipped headline text — most-copied AI flourish
Inter as the typeface — the AI-default font
glassmorphism blur — applied indiscriminately by AI
indigo->purple gradient — the AI hero default

density_watch._comment: Fine once; a cluster of these in one file is the tell.

hard_ban._comment: Markdown bleed: literal markdown rendered in a .docx means raw LLM paste.

patterns.msg: literal markdown heading (### ) inside a rendered docx — raw LLM paste
literal **bold** markdown inside a rendered docx — raw LLM paste
raster image embedded in an SVG — AI logo masquerading as vector
